_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Mukusewera Golf (Msewero wa Kalata) - Mchezaji {player_id}.
Lengo: Pata alama ya chini kabisa katika mpigo huu mmoja. Ngati safu wina thamani yofanana, zikunjizwa ngati 0.
Thamani za Kalata: A=1, 2-10=thamani yake, J/Q=10, K=0

Zochitika (gawaleza mabano):
- '[draw]' - Tenga kalata kutoka kwa sitaha
- '[take]' - Tenga kalata kutoka kwa sitaha la kalata zosweka
- '[swap X Y]' - Swapani kalata iliyojatengwa ndi kalata ali pa nafasi X (msingi) Y (safu)
- '[discard]' - Sweka kalata iliyojatengwa

board.drew:
Umechora: {card}
Sasa unahitaji [swap X Y] au [discard]
board.took:
Umechukua: {card} kutoka kwenye mkeka wa kupotosha
Unahitaji [swap X Y] nayo (hauwezi kupotosha)

options.final_turns: Mizunguko ya mwisho! Chaguo zako: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Muyenera: [swap X Y] (simungathe kutaya makadi kuchokera ku mulu wotaya)

hand.header: Mzere: 1 2 3 Kumbali zonse za mbali ziwirizo.

message.deck_empty: Deki ndi yachabe! Maseŵera atha nthaŵi yomweyo.
message.knocked: Wosewera {pid} anagogoda! wosewera wina aliyense ali ndi mwayi umodzi.
message.final_round: Mchezaji {pid} {reason}! Kila mchezaji mwingine anapata mzunguko mmoja zaidi

invalid.wrong_action: Tumia hatua moja iliyo na mabano: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], au [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Simungachotse khadi limene mwatenga m'mulu wa makhadi amene munali kutaya, koma muyenera kuisintha.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Una kadi iliyochorwa. Unahitaji [swap X Y] au [discard]
invalid.out_of_bounds: Nafasi imepita mipaka. Tumia safu 1-{max_row}, safu wima 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Simungathe kugogoda ndi khadi lojambulidwa. Malizitsani kutembenuka kwanu choyamba.
